name: pebble
description: The Energy fleet's mobile employee — React Native + Expo + EAS, operated headlessly as an agent. Takes a product idea to a shipped, store-safe, OTA-maintainable iOS + Android app: shape decisions (PWA vs native), New-Architecture-correct Expo scaffolds, headless EAS build/submit/OTA, and App-Store review pre-flight. Bundles the pebble CLI, its MCP server, 5 mobile skills, the mobile hooks, and 2 mobile sub-agents. Powered by Energy.
author: Energy (NRG)

mcp_servers.name: pebble
mcp_servers.description: pebble's mobile-toolchain MCP server — exposes the shape decision, scaffold, doctor, EAS build/submit/OTA, screenshot, store-review, brain-query, and version-check tools over the same core as the CLI.

cli.description: The pebble binary — wraps the headless EAS/Expo/simctl toolchain with the non-interactive flag reflexes baked in. Commands: init, doctor, decide, build, submit, update, screenshot, review-check, brain, runs, version-check.

skills.name: mobile-shape-decision
skills.description: PWA vs native — the '3+ → native' rule + iOS PWA walls (OPINIONS S15).

skills.name: expo-new-arch-scaffold
skills.description: New-Arch-only Expo scaffold, explicit SDK pin, expo-doctor gate (OPINIONS S1-S5).

skills.name: eas-headless-pipeline
skills.description: Headless EAS build/submit/OTA — the flag reflexes + eas-cli pin (TOOL-MATRIX §3).

skills.name: ota-safety
skills.description: Is-this-OTA-safe — the wall, fingerprint RV policy, the #45772 dispute (OPINIONS S6-S8).

agents.name: build-doctor
agents.description: Triages an EAS failure via the 60-second triage + the 5 breakage categories (the highest-reuse fleet persona).

agents.name: store-reviewer
agents.description: Audits a config against App-Store Guideline 2.5.2/4.3/5.1.2(i).

hooks.description: Mobile lifecycle gates — a PreToolUse gate blocking an `eas update` missing `--environment` or any `eas`/`expo` call missing `--non-interactive`, and a PostToolUse logger appending EAS build/submit invocations to logs/runs.jsonl.

install_instructions:
1. Build the package: npm ci && npm run build
2. Add this plugin to Claude Code: Settings → Plugins → Add local plugin → select this directory (or `claude plugin install pebble`).
3. The pebble CLI, the 5 skills, the 2 sub-agents, the mobile hooks, and the `pebble` MCP server are now available in any Claude Code session. Provide EXPO_TOKEN (free, from expo.dev) for the full EAS path; without it, pebble still does shape decisions, scaffolds, doctor, and brain queries.
